Job_Description":" Job Description


Full Stack Developer React/Next.js, Node.js/Python


3-4 Years of Experience



About the Role


We are looking for a talented and motivated Full Stack Developer with 3-4 years of experience who can work across front-end and back-end technologies. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience with React/Next.js, Node.js, and Python , along with the ability to work with AI tools and modern development technologies .
Key Responsibilities


Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable web applications using React/Next.js and Node.js.

Work on backend logic, API development, and database integrations using Node and Python.

Utilize and integrate AI tools and AI-driven features within the development workflow or applications.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including designers, PMs, and QA.

Write clean, maintainable, and optimized code following best practices.

Debug and resolve technical issues across the entire application stack.

Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies.

Integrate third-party APIs, authentication systems, and cloud services.

Ensure application responsiveness, performance, and security.



Requirements Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience with React or Next.js for front-end development.

Good working knowledge of Node.js for backend development.

Experience with Python (API development, automation, or scripting).

Ability to work with or adapt to AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, AI-based automation tools).

Understanding of relational and non-relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.

Familiarity with Git/version control and CI/CD pipelines.

Good knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) is an advantage.

Strong analytical, logical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.



Benefits
5 days working

Flexible working hours

Yearly bonus

Curated learning, growth career plan

Certification reimbursement
